استحقرا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْقَرَا (istaḥqarā) /is.taħ.qa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اُسْتُحْقِرَا (ustuḥqirā) /us.tuħ.qi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اِسْتَحْقِرَا (istaḥqirā) /is.taħ.qi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
